test_neural_network_and_oracle_skills: test the Navigate, Pick, Place, Open, and Close robot skills using neural network or oracle agents in Habitat-Sim
test_object_state_skills: test object state manipulation skills like Clean, Fill, Pour, PowerOn, and PowerOff on simulated objects
test_floors: test robot skills that interact with floor objects including rearranging items between floors and counters
test_oracle_point_skills: test oracle point navigation and point pick skills by navigating to specific 3D coordinates in the simulation
execute_skill: execute a high-level skill action like Navigate, Pick, or Place and return the agent responses and step count
